edits.old: Then the case is placed in the exception queue for role "RW-TEAMMGR" with the gap, and no default version, terms or timer is assumed
edits.new:
Then the case is placed in the exception queue for role "RW-TEAMMGR" with the gap, and no default version, terms or timer is assumed

  Scenario: AC10 The business rules with no criterion hold on the treatment write (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a restructure is proposed with 36 installments and first due date 2026-12-31
    When the treatment is written and read back
    Then the case holds exactly one treatment row with its type, terms, approval level, decision log entry and outcome (BR1)
    Then installments is above zero and first_due_date is on or after the proposed date, or the write is refused (BR2)
    Then first_due_date, installments, installment_amount, installments_paid and installment_shortfall are held and published, and no clock is written (BR3)
    Then the cure period and the warning are read as CURE_PERIOD_DAYS and plan.warn-days and are not written in code (BR4)
    Then a repeated key is ignored and counted on the request and on the consumed event (BR6)
    Then no case state is moved and no timer is written by this service (BR7)
    Then the state is one of "APPROVED", "BOOKED", "RUNNING", "BROKEN", "COMPLETED" or "CANCELED" (BR8)
    Then no list value and no parameter is written in code or in a migration (BR10)

  Scenario: AC11 A request without a valid credential or the right is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a treatment in state "APPROVED"
    When GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} is called without a valid credential
    Then the answer is 401 and no treatment content is returned
    When the same read is called by a role without Treatment and offer R
    Then the answer is 403 and no treatment content is returned

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out write is answered once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the treatment contract fake answers the create after a timeout
    When POST /cases/{caseId}/treatments is retried with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then one treatment row, one decision_record row and one outbox_event row exist in rwb_treatment
    Then the repeat is counted and the first answer is returned

  Scenario: AC13 A consumed call that fails or does not answer writes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the parameters or reference-data read does not answer
    When POST /cases/{caseId}/treatments is called for a restructure
    Then no treatment row, no decision record and no outbox row are written
    Then no default value of CURE_PERIOD_DAYS, plan.warn-days or any list is used and the failure is raised
